note: Full-hookup campground minutes from Elkins and the Monongahela National Forest, with a row of creekside sites along the west edge; cabins too. Monthly $650-750 incl. utilities; limited seasonal sites. Google 4.4 over 87 reviews. --Claude
summary: Fees $50-60 confirmed (2026 pricing page) and hookups 50A/water/sewer + wifi confirmed manual; added year-round season and phone booking. Note: dropped the nightly-rate, hookup and RV Life restatements.
flags: US$50 gate: base is exactly $50 for a party of four before tax (creekside $60; plus a 3.5% card fee) - at the line. No gateway within 40 km (nearest Shenandoah NP 127 km) and the family has not stayed here (no trip references).

Long-stay test: monthly RV ($650-750) and 'Seasonal Sites: Limited spaces' are sold beside the nightly rate; nightly sites are clearly for sale, so it reads as a transient park with some monthly/seasonal sites.
